tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens let n8n and scripts act on your account without your password. Each token shows its secret only once.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.secretWarning: Copy it now: it is shown only this once and cannot be recovered. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.

guide.title: Connect n8n in 4 steps
guide.intro: n8n collects postings and sends your daily summary. It needs a token to act on your account.

s1.title: Create a token
s1.text: Give it a name such as “n8n” and press Create token above. Its secret appears once.

s2.title: Put the token in your .env
s2.text: Open the .env file next to docker-compose.yml and add this line (replace an empty JOBRADAR_API_TOKEN= if it is there). Never share it or commit it.

s3.title: Restart n8n
s3.text: In a terminal, in the project folder, run:

s4.title: Import and activate the workflows
s4.a: Open n8n at http://localhost:5678 and go to Workflows.
s4.b: Choose Import from file and pick both files in n8n/workflows/ (01-collect-getonboard and 02-daily-summary-telegram).
s4.c: Open each one and turn on the Active switch.
s4.check: Check it worked: in Executions the runs are green and this page shows “last used”. A 401 error means the token is wrong or was revoked: create a new one and repeat from step 2.
